verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting those agents connect to external MCP servers is a fair axis for this product. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Ramp acting as an MCP server: Ramp MCP, Developer MCP and Ramp Data MCP are consumed by Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar clients. Nothing shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into Ramp so its agents can call their tools, and server-side capability cannot be credited to this client-side story.
